effectiveDate.original: 20 мая 1955 г. — вступление соглашения 1954 г. в силу

geometry.derivationNote: UN Treaty Series Vol. 451, No. 6497 publishes annex cartography that distinguishes the existing Soviet-Iranian frontier from the new line established by the 2 December 1954 agreement, so the authoritative map source is now located. Article II also segments the legal reconstruction: large intervals retain the 18 January 1829 Beyramlu description while Mugan, Deman and Eddy-Evlyar receive new lines, and the eastern sector is separately defined. The published annex maps must be georeferenced under the raster provenance/commercial-rights gate; the 11 April 1957 demarcation package and coordinate catalogue remain the preferred precision cross-check before promotion to geometry-verified.

territoryChanges.notes: The source map is located, but production geometry remains intentionally unchanged until controlled georeferencing, rights review and cross-checking against the 1957 demarcation material are complete.

effectiveDate.original: 11 апреля 1957 г. — дата документов демаркации и редемаркации

geometry.derivationNote: The 11 April 1957 package demarcates and documents the frontier already legally settled by the 1954 agreement effective 20 May 1955; it is not a second external territorial mutation. Its coordinate catalogue and maps remain valuable source material for reconstructing the 1955 line, but this 1957 metadata event itself requires no separate territory-area geometry action.

territoryChanges.notes: Demarcation implementation of the already-effective 1955 legal frontier. Coordinate material should be attached to the 1955 spatial reconstruction rather than treated as a new 1957 territorial change.
